title: Brazilian Vegan Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegan biryani dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine, featuring a mix of spices and vegetables.

ingredients.name: Vegetables (such as bell peppers, carrots, and zucchini)
Pungent spices (such as cumin and coriander)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the pungent spices and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the diced vegetables and cooked biryanis, and stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes, Brazilian-style salsa, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Transfer the biryani mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
